title: OSI Hackathon Schema
description: Equilibrium solution data with phases, extracted amounts, PubChem substances, and publication references.
$comment: Validates an EquilibriumSolution data object, without an EntryArchive data wrapper. Fields remain optional as in schema.archive.yaml. Numeric values use the declared storage units, except Amount.value, which uses Amount.units. The unit keyword preserves NOMAD storage units; JSON Schema validators do not convert units or run NOMAD normalizers. Each phase has an optional substance described by PubChemPureSubstanceSection.

ArchiveSection.title: ArchiveSection
ArchiveSection.description: Base for archive sections with NOMAD normalization support.

m_def.description: Optional NOMAD section definition reference for selecting a concrete section type.

EntryData.title: EntryData
EntryData.description: Base for the data section of a NOMAD entry; adds no quantities.

BaseSection.title: BaseSection
BaseSection.description: Shared descriptive metadata for NOMAD sections.

datetime.description: Date and time associated with the section.

lab_id.description: Identifier unique within the laboratory producing the data.

description.description: Additional information not captured by the other fields.

ComponentBase.title: NOMAD Component
ComponentBase.description: Amounts and identifying information for a component in a mixture.

mass_fraction.description: Component mass divided by the mixture mass.

PureSubstanceSection.title: PureSubstanceSection
PureSubstanceSection.description: Chemical identity and molecular properties of a pure substance.

iupac_name.description: Systematic IUPAC name of the substance.

molecular_mass.description: Mass of a molecule with the most likely isotopic composition.

molar_mass.description: Mass per mole using the substance's isotopic composition.

monoisotopic_mass.description: Molecular mass calculated from the most abundant isotope of each element.

canonical_smile.description: Canonical SMILES representation of the structure.

PubChemPureSubstanceSection.title: PubChemPureSubstanceSection
PubChemPureSubstanceSection.description: Pure substance with PubChem compound identifiers and inherited chemical properties.
PubChemPureSubstanceSection.$comment: JSON Schema validation does not populate defaults or fetch PubChem data.

pub_chem_link.description: Link to the PubChem compound record.

PureSubstanceComponent.title: PureSubstanceComponent
PureSubstanceComponent.description: Mixture component linked to its pure-substance details.

substance_name.description: Substance name used within the containing mixture.

pure_substance.description: Chemical properties of the substance forming this component.

Component.title: Component
Component.description: Pure-substance component with amounts and PubChem substance details.

PublicationReference.title: PublicationReference
PublicationReference.description: Bibliographic details for a related publication or dataset.

DOI_number.description: DOI identifying the publication or dataset.

Amount.title: Amount
Amount.description: An extracted amount with its measure type, numeric value, and units.

type.description: Kind of amount, such as molarity, molality, mass fraction, molar fraction, or partial pressure.

value.description: Numerical value of the extracted amount in the specified units.

units.description: Units associated with the value, such as mol/L, mol/kg, Pa, or dimensionless.

name.description: Short descriptive name identifying this phase within the equilibrium solution.

state_of_matter.description: Physical state of the phase, such as solid, liquid, or gas.

amount.description: Extracted amount expressed by its type, value, and units.

substance.description: Chemical identity and PubChem details of the substance forming this phase.

pressure.description: Gas pressure over the solution (assumed to be isobar).

measurement_methods.description: Methods used to measure the equilibrium properties of the solution.

mixing_methods.description: Methods used to mix the components when preparing the solution.
